test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following do/does NOT come under Union list of seventh schedule of the Indian constitution?

options.text: Audit of the accounts of the states

solution:
The correct answer is __**Intoxicating liquors.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The seventh schedule of the Indian constitution deals with the division of powers between the central government and the state governments through three lists: **the Union List, the State List, and the Concurrent List.**
 
• **The Union List **consists of subjects on which the central government has exclusive legislative authority.
 
• This means that only the** Parliament of India can make laws **regarding the items mentioned in the Union List.
 
• The Union List includes subjects of national importance or those that require uniform laws throughout the country.
 
• It encompasses areas such as **defense, foreign affairs, atomic energy, railways, communication, and more.**
 
• In this way, all the other options lie on the union list except intoxicating liquors.</
